name: Aurora
description: Aurora is a universal digital world that unifies entertainment, commerce, social, learning, creativity, productivity, travel, finance, health, home control, and intelligent automation inside a single, emotionally intelligent website.

corePrinciples.clarity: Every surface feels intentional, readable, and grounded.
corePrinciples.emotion: Aurora speaks in a warm, mythic, inspiring tone.
corePrinciples.adaptation: The interface adapts to identity, context, mood, and device.
corePrinciples.unity: Every domain feels like part of one coherent world.

universes.name: Home Universe
universes.tagline: Your digital home — calm, clear, and beautifully yours.
universes.purpose: Provide a personal control center for life inside Aurora.

universes.name: Entertainment Universe
universes.tagline: Every story, every song, every moment — in one place.
universes.purpose: Unify video, music, live events, and media discovery inside Aurora.

universes.name: Commerce Universe
universes.tagline: Shop the entire internet from one place.
universes.purpose: Offer a unified shopping experience with a single Aurora checkout.

universes.name: Social Universe
universes.tagline: All your worlds, one social fabric.
universes.purpose: Unify social feeds, messaging, and communities.

universes.name: Learning Universe
universes.purpose: Provide a global academy for structured and self-directed learning.

universes.name: create (Creative Universe)
universes.purpose: Offer a multi-panel creative studio for surfaces, campaigns, and stories.

universes.name: Brand Universe
universes.tagline: Your brand is a living mind.
universes.purpose: Host brand identity, guidelines, assets, and campaigns.

universes.name: Community Universe
universes.purpose: Provide spaces for creators, brands, and topics.

universes.name: Gaming Universe
universes.purpose: Unify gaming libraries, clips, and events.

universes.name: Productivity Universe
universes.tagline: Work with clarity. Create with flow.
universes.purpose: Provide tools for planning, organizing, and executing.

universes.name: Travel Universe
universes.purpose: Help users plan and track trips.

universes.name: Finance Universe
universes.tagline: Understand your money. Shape your future.
universes.purpose: Offer a clear view of spending, subscriptions, and goals.

universes.name: Automation & Agents
universes.purpose: Define agents and routines that automate digital life.

interaction.hover: Lift, glow, and subtle motion to signal interactivity.
interaction.scroll: Smooth, momentum-based scrolling with optional parallax.
interaction.navigation: Soft transitions between sections with clear context.
